sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The "Release info - Data quality" 📊 dropdown section never appeared on a relationship listing's "Title" column (e.g. an artist's Relationships tab) even when the relationship's target is a release carrying MusicBrainz's own native high/low-data-quality marker — the section's eligibility check was gated on the column being literally named "Release", which a relationship-target column never is (it can point to any entity kind, so MusicBrainz always calls it "Title"). The gate now also accepts "Title", additionally checking each cell's own native `<span class="releaselink">` marker so a relationship targeting a non-release entity is never miscounted as "normal quality".
